limitations: This diagnostic samples broad transport/capture activity outside the wait marker; it does not change click selection or completion rules.
Sample spacing is at least two seconds, not a guaranteed two-second cadence. Actual observed gaps were 6860–30087 ms.
The same marker getter is called both before and after screenshot capture. Samples have no phase tag and cannot reconstruct every waitTransition input.
Endpoint URLs and parameters were deliberately not recorded in activity; no particular background service can be identified.
